comments.author: OjosDeAzul
comments.body:
IMPORTANT: ERROR IN TICKET DESCRIPTION: The ticket description for this says Modified Long Merchant Schooner, when it is in fact a Modified Large Trading Schooner.

UPDATE: I'm not sure how accurate this is, as was from a random person in Seville, but was told she had an offer for a ticket for 7b, and saw another sold at 10b! Overpriced? Maybe, but does support my opinion that it's better than CLMS.
